# Pandamonium v1.0.65

This train closes the Wave 5 research lanes (robotics inventory, Unsloth training runtime and jobs, the first read-only cybersecurity tranche selection) plus the operator-reported plugin-manager and composer fixes: mirrored skill repos now scan and install, the Add Plugins modal gains a dedicated Marketplace tab, oversized MCP list results name their recovery path, the composer model logo is icon-sized with pill chips across the row, and the reasoning control reflects each model's real capability with five named tiers.

## MAD-794 — Books: inventory and deduplicate jimmyval92/robotics_ebooks

### Problem

The robotics library import needed a licensing and duplication decision before any PDF entered CT103, and no reproducible inventory of the pinned source existed.

### Implementation

Pinned snapshot `5441f772` (tree `ab976a02`) of `jimmyval92/robotics_ebooks` was inventoried with a reproducible generator (`scripts/inventory_robotics_ebooks.py`, `--verify` passing): 107 PDFs totalling 1,790,948,281 bytes, matching the prior audit with zero discrepancy, zero exact duplicates. The audit verdict is **0 approve / 107 skip** because the repository declares no license; per-file rows (path, title, size, git blob SHA-1, license status, recommendation) land in `docs/inventory/` as JSON/CSV plus the audit narrative. Nothing was downloaded, imported, or redistributed.

### Product value and UI visibility

The operator now has an exact, reproducible licensing decision surface. The follow-up import issue (MAD-795) remains correctly gated: unknown licensing is never approved for import, so the lane is a no-op until Leo approves an explicit subset from a licensed source.

### Verification

Generator `--verify` asserted byte counts and tree identity; size-bucket estimates explicitly defer to post-download hashing. CI green at merge (full Python suite, browser suite, scans).

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

No runtime change. The upstream repository has no license file or metadata, and SHA-256 cannot be known before acquisition; both facts are recorded rather than guessed.

### References

- [Linear MAD-794](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-794)
- [Robotics inventory PR #236](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/236)

## MAD-796 — Training: integrate Unsloth Studio as an external runtime

### Problem

Training support required an external Unsloth runtime that stays out of the base Pandamonium image and is visible to the operator through the existing settings surface.

### Implementation

Adds the Unsloth Studio external runtime adapter plus a **Training Runtime** settings tab that documents and binds the adapter contract: external process, bounded workspace, reviewed data flows. Feature commits `a1f5a443`, `d1f8231a`, `b46e519c`, `4658b9f8`; PR #234.

### Product value and UI visibility

Operators configure and monitor an optional training runtime from Settings without bloating the base install; the adapter contract documents boundaries and health expectations.

### Verification

Focused adapter/doc tests and the PR visual capture are part of the train; full CI (6390+ Python, browser suite, scans) green at merge.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Optional runtime only; no change to the base image chain or default paths. Registered outputs (MAD-798) follow in a later train.

### References

- [Linear MAD-796](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-796)

## MAD-797 — Training: add reviewed datasets and observable cancellable jobs

### Problem

Training data and jobs lacked review manifests, real ORM persistence, and an operator path to observe or cancel in-flight work.

### Implementation

Adds reviewed dataset manifests with bounds and the collection-time real-model pinning required by the persistence layer, plus observable, cancellable training jobs with documented lifecycle and review workflows (`b2735404`, `a87995a0`, `0214b567`, `b213d3d6`; PR #238). Routes and payloads are ready; the Settings-tab surface for these jobs is intentional follow-on work.

### Product value and UI visibility

Dataset provenance and job state now survive restarts and expose cancellation; the tampered-credential fixture proves review metadata cannot smuggle secrets into job records.

### Verification

Focused training tests include the real-model pin and the allowlisted tamper fixture; full CI green at merge.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Backend-first slice: no Settings UI for jobs yet. Registered GGUF/LoRA outputs in the Cookbook remain the next lane (MAD-798).

## MAD-799 — Security: select the first read-only cybersecurity package tranche

### Problem

The M12 security packages needed a defensible, operator-signable shortlist before any adaptation work.

### Implementation

Selection and threat-model deliverables (`docs/security/mad-799-tranche-one-selection.md`, `mad-799-tranche-one-threat-model.md`, evidence JSON) recommend tranche one: **syft-sbom, grype-vuln, osv-deps, gitleaks-secrets, checkdmarc-dns, cyclonedx-reports** (approve), **chainsaw-logs and testssl-tls** (conditional on GPL packaging/single-target gates), configuration-audit tools deferred to tranche two. Exploitation, credential, persistence, evasion, destructive-response, and unrestricted-scanning categories are explicitly excluded.

### Product value and UI visibility

Every candidate maps to one narrow operator question, is defensive and read-only, declares network boundaries, and runs as the ordinary service user. No package is implemented, downloaded, published, installed, or pointed at a target by this issue — Leo approves the list before adaptation begins (MAD-800).

### Verification

Threat model and selection docs pass the marker scan; full CI green at merge.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Research slice with an explicit approval boundary; nothing ships until the operator signs the tranche.

### References

- [Linear MAD-799](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-799)
- [Security tranche PR #240](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/240)

## MAD-895 — Portal: keep large read-tool list results usable instead of truncating to a dead end

### Problem

An oversized Portal read result (e.g. `discord.list_channels`) truncated with no recovery path, costing rounds in a dead-end loop.

### Implementation

The generic projection already preserved whole records and the server cursor; the truncation notice now names both recovery paths explicitly: reread with a smaller limit from the same cursor, or use a precise name/ID resolver tool for one target. Added deterministic unit coverage (`tests/test_tool_result_projection.py`, red-first) for the notice wording, provider-agnostic projection, the empty fallback, and non-framed trim. Commit `24df4978`; PR #245.

### Product value and UI visibility

A truncated list is never a silent dead end: the agent is told exactly how to continue, and the passed cursor can still be advanced safely.

### Verification

Full Python suite 6385 passed / 5 skipped; CI fully green including the 151-spec browser suite.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

No API change; the reminder is generic to any native MCP tool beyond the 8,000-char budget.

### References

- [Linear MAD-895](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-895)
- [Projection recovery PR #245](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/245)

## MAD-950 — Plugins UI: add a Marketplace tab and keep the Add tab to GitHub intake only

### Problem

The catalog browser (installed listing for public packages) rendered inside the Add a new plugin tab, mixing two intents.

### Implementation

The Add Plugins modal now has three tabs — **Installed plugins | Marketplace | Add a new plugin**. The signed-catalog toolbar, results, and plugin detail moved into the Marketplace panel; the Add tab keeps only GitHub URL intake, scan progress, findings, draft preview, and install approval. Arrow-key rotation covers all three tabs. Commit `46d3acf1`; PR #247.

### Product value and UI visibility

Installed things live in Installed, the community catalog lives in Marketplace, and Add is only for bringing something new in — matching the operator request.

### Verification

Marketplace, intake, and installed browser specs update to the three-tab structure with a new assertion that the Add tab shows no catalog cards; 7 focused specs green and the full 179-spec CI browser suite green at merge.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

UI restructure only; no catalog, install, or lifecycle contract changed.

### References

- [Linear MAD-950](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-950)
- [Marketplace tab PR #247](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/247)

## MAD-951 — Extensions: scan fails on repos that mirror the same skills across tool directories

### Problem

Pasting `https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail` into Add from GitHub failed at the Report phase with the generic setup error. The repository ships the same six skills under both `.openclaw/skills/` and `skills/`, producing duplicate capability names that the report-stage artifact validation rejected.

### Implementation

`_extract()` now keeps the first capability per name in deterministic path order, so mirrored skill layouts scan into one unique capability each. `extension_scan_capability_duplicate` also maps to human copy for any residual case. Red-first fixture (`tests/test_extension_scan_skill_mirrors.py`) mirrors the real layout. Commit `78bba8c4`; PR #246.

### Product value and UI visibility

Repos that mirror skills for several agent tools — the common pattern — now scan successfully and produce a reviewable draft manifest instead of a dead-end error.

### Verification

Fixture fails on main and passes on the fix; live re-scan of `DietrichGebert/ponytail` reaches `succeeded` with 7 unique capabilities and a valid skills draft. Full Python suite 6386 passed / 5 skipped.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

No API change; duplicate names resolve to their first (sorted-path) occurrence deterministically.

### References

- [Linear MAD-951](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-951)
- [Scan dedupe PR #246](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/246)

## MAD-952 — Composer: fix blown-up model logo, unify pill chips, and capability-matched reasoning levels

### Problem

On the composer, the provider logo rendered oversized behind the input row, the model and reasoning chips were square beside the pill identity selector, and the reasoning control showed "Default" with only three tiers regardless of model capability.

### Implementation

Provider logos in composer/menu controls are pinned to icon size by a top-level rule independent of viewport-scoped sizing, all three chips share the identity pill geometry, and the OpenRouter reasoning vocabulary is extended to five tiers (`low/medium/high/xhigh/max` displayed as Low, Medium, High, Extra High, Ultra — matching OpenRouter's documented effort values), while OpenAI and Mistral stay on their valid three. Effort validation is provider-specific. The reasoning mode now activates from the served `reasoning_levels` map even when startup data settles out of module order (composer-label observer plus pick signals), showing the effective level or "Model default". Commit `01a373ea`; PR #248.

### Product value and UI visibility

The composer row is visually consistent, the model mark is icon-sized, and the reasoning slider offers exactly what the selected model supports, with names that match real settings.

### Verification

New browser spec `composer-reasoning-controls.spec.js` asserts the ≤16px logo, "Model default" chip, 999px radii, five-tier slider, and "Ultra" at the top step; reasoning contract tests updated (63 green, incl. provider-specific rejection of five-tier levels on OpenAI/Mistral); full Python suite 6389 passed / 5 skipped; full browser CI green.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

The five-tier vocabulary rides only models served by providers whose effort contract accepts it; "ultra" remains a display name, never a wire value.

### References

- [Linear MAD-952](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-952)
- [Composer controls PR #248](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/248)
